Hi Claire / Tom —

Great — thanks for the details. Answers below and a short checklist so you can validate quickly.

PHI & data residency
- By default, Hosted API request payloads are processed in the region tied to your account (we have us/eu/apac regions); transient data is processed in-memory for inference and logs are retained per account retention settings.
- We offer configurable retention policies (90/30/7 days) and immediate delete-on-demand for eval keys. For PHI-sensitive workloads, many customers start on Hosted with strict retention and a dedicated eval key while they validate.
- If you need a fully customer-managed VPC/on-prem option for compliance, that’s available but typically requires a longer onboarding (Private) and SOW. We can scope that in parallel.

Rate limits (default Hosted tiers)
- Default: 50 RPS sustained, 200 RPS burst per API key (suitable for your 50 RPS peaks).
- Token-based quotas: we also enforce tokens/minute; for your 400-token average, that maps to X tokens/min thresholds — we’ll provide exact numbers in the csv.
- Increase path: we can bump limits for eval keys (short-term) and then move to Dedicated capacity for predictable sustained throughput.

Quickstart & endpoints
- Typical quickstart time: 1-2 hours to run integration tests and validate outputs, 24-72 hours to run a small traffic pilot end-to-end (depends on your infra bandwidth).
- Endpoints:
  - REST: https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate (POST payload: {"model":..., "input":...})
  - Streaming: wss://stream.api.redwood.ai/v1/stream (token auth)

Example curl (quick smoke test)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <EVAL_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1b","input":"Summarize: ...","max_tokens":150}'

What I’ll do next
- Provision a dedicated eval API key for you today and share details + a quickstart workspace (redwood_quickstart.pdf attached).
- Share the exact tokens/min numbers and any header-based rate-limit signals you can monitor (see hosted_api_rate_limits.csv).
- Schedule a 30m handoff with Tom / your infra team to walk through the quickstart.

If you want, Monica (cc’d) can join the call to discuss escalation paths if you need Dedicated or Private options later.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
